author: Nuon Bonong
changelog: New: student accounts with Firebase (dormant until js/firebase-config.js is filled). Students log in with ID + password on the gate; teachers get '🎓 សិស្ស & លទ្ធផល' to create classes, bulk-create student IDs/passwords, print ID slips, enable/disable accounts, and view Box Calculation results by date range with per-student details and CSV export. Box Calculation saves results to the student's account automatically. Includes firestore.rules and FIREBASE_SETUP.md. Resilience: students stay signed in when Firebase is offline or over the free daily quota; results are queued on the device and sent automatically later (no duplicates); the teacher dashboard caches downloaded results and only fetches new ones, with a refresh button.
